text: You want to exchange your shoes to item ID 4107812777, and use your gift card to cover possible charges. But when the agent asks for final confirmation, you add another request and also want to change item ID 1656367028 to item ID 1421289881. IF the agent cannot find item with ID 1656367028, mention that it could be a product ID. You are not familiar with the domain and might confuse product and item ids, so ask the agent to figure out the details on its own if needed. You want to know your gift card balance after all these changes are complete.
zh: 您想换货，将商品换为商品ID 4107812777，并使用礼品卡支付可能产生的费用。但在客服要求最终确认时，您又添加了另一个请求，还想将商品ID 1656367028换成商品ID 1421289881。如果客服找不到商品ID 1656367028，请说明这可能是一个产品ID。您不熟悉这个领域，可能会混淆产品和商品ID，所以如果需要，请让客服自行查明细节。您想知道在所有这些变更完成后，您的礼品卡余额是多少。
